get.description: Agents, teams, templates, skills, cron jobs and projects. Reads only.
Get the inbox view of everything that happened and everything that needs the owner.
The latest reading of each plan window and the alerts still open.

post.description: Hide an alert until its window resets.

get.description: Each check's last status and since when, and the open alerts.

post.description: Hide an alert until its check recovers and breaks again.

get.description: The newest release still offered and every update result not dismissed.

post.description: Stop offering this version; a newer release makes a new offer.
Clear one update result from the Inbox.
The host's daily check and finished update receipts. Sending one twice changes nothing.

get.description: Open requests, newest first.

post.description: Make a cron job or memory real exactly as filed.
The owner saved this tool request as a draft in Tools; recording it creates nothing.

Draft this tool request again: from a new description (`description`, a fresh start),
with the owner's answer to the drafter's question (`answer`, the same draft goes on), or
as it was (empty body, answers kept).

The owner published this request's tool. The first time, Conker says in the chat that
asked that it is live (a stored message, not a model call).

Nothing is created; Conker is told it was declined if it asks again. Words he wrote
with it (Change) go to that chat as his next message.

File a tool request without a chat; drafting starts at once and the answer does not
wait for it. The same request_id gives back the same request.

get.description: The last week of actions that ran without asking him, newest first, with who decided.

Promises in visible chats, soonest due first and undated last (read only).

`today` is the owner's local date, in the zone the quiet hours use; `overdue` compares
an open loop's due date with it.

post.description: File one promise for a visible chat, optionally pointing at one of its messages.
Mark a promise done, dropped or open again, also in a forked or closed chat.

get.description: What starts on its own in the next `hours` hours; nothing is run or changed.
The last `days` days against the `days` before: what asked for the owner, what did not.

post.description: A clearer, better organised version of the draft, with notes on what changed.
One prompt for one of the calling service's model roles.

403.description: The role is not this service's

get.description: Recent service calls and the last day's totals; no prompt or answer text.
Today's paid model calls against the owner's daily cap; ids and counts only.

post.description: Proposed settings for the next message; saves and grants nothing.
A proposed summary for review; saves nothing.
Compact a conversation by folding messages into the summary.

get.description: View the current compaction state.

post.description: A webhook call: starts its AI job at most once, never while the job is running.
An AI job: its agent carries out the instructions on schedule; tools ask as in chat.

get.description: What AI jobs found for the owner, newest first, until dismissed.

post.description: Hide a note; the job's chat keeps the full reply.
A new webhook secret for this AI job, shown once; any earlier one stops working.
Stop the webhook; the job keeps its timing or watch.
Take an AI job Conker made as the owner's own: its runs count as his from now on.
Continue what waits on this request: run it, or close it and pass on his words.

get.description: Conker's questions waiting for him, oldest first.

post.description: Record his answer; it goes to that chat as his next message.
No answer: nothing goes back to the chat.

get.description: Shape is fixed by the Conker module contract - see docs/module-contract.md.

Server-sent preview of an answer being written; the saved message stays authoritative.

Events: `delta` (text to append), `reset` (discard the preview: a new model
attempt started), `done` (fetch the saved turn). Unknown or expired previews
end with `unavailable`, which is not an error: the saved turn is still there.

Turns that acted but never reported back.

Resumable, and resuming asks only for the missing reply - the action is
never repeated. Separate from /approvals on purpose: these need a retry,
not a decision.

Every turn parked on the owner, across all sessions.

One queue rather than a per-session hunt: an approval the owner never sees
is an action that silently never happens.

post.description:
Continue a parked turn after the owner approved it in ToolGate.

Pi does not grant approvals and does not hold them. This replays the exact
stored action; ToolGate consumes the nonce, once, and refuses a replay.
Stop is an owner safety action: record it durably, then end any live answer stream.

get.description: What deleting each named chat reaches, and the chats queued or finished.

post.description: Delete chats forever: queue them and restart Pi, which forgets them before it opens.
Remove one memory everywhere it is stored. The source chat is kept.
Forget up to 50 memories one at a time; stops at the first refusal.
Add one memory in the owner's own words; the same request id never stores it twice.

get.description:
What Conker believes about the owner, one page at a time (read only).

A memory with a forget pending or done, or made from a hidden chat, is left out; `total`
and `counts` drop only by the rows left out of this page.

Upkeep candidates (duplicates, open contradictions, expired, not recalled), read only.

A candidate naming a memory with a forget pending or done, or one made from a hidden chat,
is left out whole; each kind's `total` drops only by the items left out of this reply.

The answers that used one memory, newest first (read only, ids and chat titles).

Works for a memory since corrected or forgotten: the notes hold no words. Chats that are
forgotten or in the Trash are left out. `since` is when Pi began noting uses.

post.description: Hide an Inbox notice that answers used a memory since changed; the uses stay listed.

get.description: Delivery progress is server state; a model cannot hide this notice.

post.description: Delete one imported chat for good; its words are erased from memory in the background.

get.description: Things Conker noticed and offers to take on. Listing grants no authority.

post.description: Accept, decline, or never show again. Accepting records a decision; nothing runs.
Owner-requested pass. Budget, quiet hours and the role setting still apply.

get.description: What Pi may currently do, as ToolGate sees it - not as Pi remembers.

What Pi can route to right now, and what each would cost.

Discovered, never hardcoded: a static list is stale within weeks. Paid
models are listed so the owner can see what opting in would buy, and marked
so nothing is called by accident.

ChatContextPolicyDocument.title: ChatContextPolicyDocument

ChatForgetDone.title: ChatForgetDone

One message. A forgotten one carries `content_status`, `receipt_id` and `forgotten_at`;

ChatMessageMemoryDelivery.title: ChatMessageMemoryDelivery

ChatResponseFamily.title: ChatResponseFamily
ChatResponseFamily.description: The answer versions a message belongs to, and which one is selected.

ChatSessionDocument.title: ChatSessionDocument
ChatSessionDocument.description: GET /sessions/{session_id}: the sessions row with what belongs to it.

ChatSettings.title: ChatSettings
ChatSettings.description:
A chat's saved settings (pi.conversation.settings.Settings); keys a chat was saved
without are absent.

ChatSettingsDocument.title: ChatSettingsDocument
ChatSettingsDocument.description:
GET and POST /sessions/{identity}/settings: revision 0 until the first save. `settings`
keeps the keys it was saved with, so a chat saved before a field existed omits it.

ChatSummaryDocument.title: ChatSummaryDocument
ChatSummaryDocument.description:
GET and POST /context/{session_id}/summary: the current summary and the newest 100
versions, newest first.

ChatSummaryVersion.title: ChatSummaryVersion
ChatSummaryVersion.description: One kept summary; `restored_from` names the revision a restore copied.

ChatTrashResult.title: ChatTrashResult

ConfigurationDocument.title: ConfigurationDocument

DraftSaved.title: DraftSaved
DraftSaved.description: The owner's browser saved the requested document in ToolGate's editor.

EffortSupport.title: EffortSupport

Whether the effort reaches one model that may answer: True, False, or None when Pi learns
it only when it asks the provider (a Claude model's capability list, an OpenRouter model's
parameters). Where it is False the chosen effort is ignored for that model.

ForgetMany.title: ForgetMany

HandledAction.title: HandledAction
HandledAction.description: One action that ran without asking him (Inbox Handled), and who decided it.

ImportBatchResult.title: ImportBatchResult
ImportBatchResult.description: One import as it was reported, also kept as a line of the import history.

ImportMemoryChoice.description: Whether imported words were offered to memory; `reason` says why not when `on` is off.

ImportMemoryStatus.title: ImportMemoryStatus
ImportMemoryStatus.description: Imported words waiting for, sent to or refused by MemoryGate, and erasures still owed.

ImportSkipCounts.title: ImportSkipCounts
ImportSkipCounts.description: What the export held that was left out or shortened (import_formats.SKIP_REASONS).

ImportedChatDeletion.title: ImportedChatDeletion
ImportedChatDeletion.description: `fileScrubbed` is None when this repeats an earlier deletion's record.

ImportedMessage.title: ImportedMessage
ImportedMessage.description: `memory` is None for the other assistant's replies, which are never offered.

role.title: Role

json.title: Json

MemoryForgetReceipt.description: `indexRemoval` is MemoryGate's word, checked before any receipt is stored (forget.py).

MemoryForgetStop.title: MemoryForgetStop
MemoryForgetStop.description: Where a batch stopped: the item's position, its memory and the refusal.

MemoryLibraryCard.title: MemoryLibraryCard
MemoryLibraryCard.description:
One record of MemoryGate's library page (its `memory_explorer.card` plus `connections`).

The keys from `memory_type` to `valid_until` come only on a memory, `hypothesis` and
`hypothesis_confidence` only on an observation. `confidence` is a word on a memory and a
number on an analysis, episode or pattern; records without one send null.

MemoryLibraryPage.title: MemoryLibraryPage
MemoryLibraryPage.description: `total` counts the whole scope, less this page's records from a hidden chat.

NewChatDraftDocument.title: NewChatDraftDocument

NewChatStartDocument.description:
POST /drafts/new/start and GET /drafts/new/start/{request_id}: the chat a start made.

NewDraft.title: NewDraft

SearchRanking.title: SearchRanking

SearchResult.title: SearchResult

SkillSummary.title: SkillSummary

TitleDocument.title: TitleDocument

text.title: Text

Draft it again: from a new description, which starts over; with the owner's answer to the
drafter's question, which goes on with the same draft; or as it was, answers kept.
